objects.source_observation: Reporter foregrounds seemingly benign observed warming, while reporting Michaels' optimism and Hansen's qualified disagreement; both scientific voices are present.
Hansen disputes the article's benign impression; argues climate models remain substantially supported and risks persist, while discussing increased winter/night warming.
Archive says the GCC letter positively promotes Michaels' view reported in the earlier article and offers journalists Michaels' research; original PDF text not independently digested.
Archive summary identifies Volume 1 Issue 9 and a front-page item foregrounding Michaels and the reporter's uncertainty framing; original PDF text has not been independently digested.
